session: Fresh-phone round: a dev session (HS256 dev JWT, user fresh-runner-android-2) as debug intent extras against the API in memory mode on 127.0.0.1:3297, reached at 10.0.2.2:3298 through a local proxy that logs every request. The race was set up as a first phone leaves it, straight against the API: POST /race-rooms (unpaid), PUT /course with course-50k-with-aids.gpx and a 6:00 AM America/Denver start, POST /activity-history/file with activity-long-trail.gpx, POST /pacing-estimates with all history and PUT …/pacing-estimate.
